title: 第1章 去当兵吧，重新活出个人样来！
novel_title: 都重生了谁还复读？去当兵吧(酸辣榔头)
content_zh: “你个狗东西！”“上学时候骗老子说，去新华书店买辅导书，结果买的就是这种东西！”“我让你看小说，我让你看小说，回头就给你这些书全给卖废品了！”陆阳身子一震，猛地惊醒过来。看着熟悉的屋子，还有面前这个发了疯一样愤怒撕书的男人，眼神充满困惑。他明明记得自已，上一秒还在流水线上打螺丝，然后再一睁眼就到了这。很快，陆阳忽然意识到，自已好像是重生了？重新回到了二十年前，那个高考落榜后的暑假了。这会儿，自已正在卧室里偷偷摸摸的看小说，然后父亲就愤怒的冲进来了。“老子供你吃喝借钱送去上高中，就是想你能考个好大学！”“结果学没学好，整天就知道看这个破小说破小说！”“我告诉你陆阳，你的好日子到头了。现在给你两条路，要么去工厂上班，要么去技校学手艺，你自已选？”父亲陆勇强的咆哮声震耳欲聋，唾沫星子喷了陆阳一脸。但陆阳却鼻头一酸，心里除了愧疚，更多的是难受。因为前世，父亲虽然严厉，但心里一直记挂着自已。为了攒钱给陆阳买房结婚，白天单位加班，下了班又背着家里人偷偷送外卖。最终积劳成疾，在一个寒冷的冬天傍晚，累倒在电动车座椅上......这时，外头传来三轮车停下的声音，母亲袁爱琴在夜市摆摊，收摊回来刚巧听到屋里的吵闹声。她顾不得许多，护袖都没来得及摘就急急忙忙的跑进来，接着就看到满地狼藉，还以为出了什么大事。袁爱琴几乎是本能的一把推开丈夫，把陆阳护在身后，像个暴怒的母狮子：“大半夜的，你干什么！？”陆勇强气的不行：“我刚下了夜班，回来就看到这小炮子大半夜不睡觉，打着手电筒看小说，气的我给他把书撕了......”陆阳连忙保证：“爸，以后我再也不看这些乱七八糟的小说了，明天天一亮我就把书还回去。”陆勇强瞪着眼睛：“书，是借的？”陆阳点头：“三毛钱一天，押金二十。”他低头看着地上这两本，尴尬的说：“这两本，应该押金应该是没法儿退了，回头卖收废品吧。”陆勇强气不打一处来，要早知道能退，他就不撕了！母亲更多的是欣慰，能够意识到错误，愿意改正总归是好事。她安慰陆阳：“儿子，其实我和你爸商量过，准备找人花钱，让你复读一年。”“你原先成绩一直都不错，只要好好学，肯定能考个好大学。”但却被陆阳摇头拒绝了，不是他不愿意复读。而是断层时间太久，他早就把当初学的东西还给老师了。即便是复读一年，怕是也考不出什么好成绩来。与其白白浪费一年时间，还不如选一条新的路。陆阳在记忆里想起，落榜后没几天，村长就曾登门，询问过他要不要去当兵的事儿？村委会负责配合人武部征兵宣传工作，有适龄青年自然得上门询问一下，再加上村长是陆阳的舅爷爷，自然对此也比较上心。但那时的陆阳极其抗拒当兵，所以想都没想就拒绝了。但在经历过社会的毒打与摧残后，陆阳想开了。当兵，苦的是身体；而走上社会，是精神和肉体的双重摧残，是各种尔虞我诈和勾心斗角。相比之下，部队的环境要好很多，只要付出了努力了，就能够得到回报。都重生了，谁还复读？干脆去当兵吧！“爸，我不想复读，也不想上技校。”听到这话，陆勇强本能的以为他是在顶嘴。先是伸手摸向腰间，才发现自已有没系裤腰带的习惯。接着目光在屋子里左右搜寻，想看看有没有什么趁手的兵器。“爸，你找啥，我帮你找？”“我在找棍子，打死你这个小炮子！”“......”陆勇强破口大骂：“不肯复读也不肯读技校，那你要干什么，你要上天啊？十八九岁就辍学去打工，你吃得了那苦，丢得起这人吗？”陆阳被唾沫星子喷了一脸，但语气却十分坚定：“爸，我想好了，我要去当兵。”母亲十分诧异：“前些天，你舅爷爷来的时候，你不还说不要去当兵吗？还说什么，当兵出来了还得找工作，还不如去技校学个技术？”陆阳坦言：“部队待遇好，退伍了还有退伍费，退役军人身份找工作也更容易。”夫妻俩显然是没料到，陆阳像是翻书一样，这么快就推翻了之前的想法？但他俩第一反应，并不是儿子当兵后，会不会吃苦。而是在想，部队能要咱儿子吗？瘦的跟竹篙似的，成天只会看小说，也不锻炼，也不打球？要知道，十岁以前的陆阳基本上就是个药罐子，几乎隔三差五就得上医院挂水打针。这也导致陆阳肤色一直呈现出一种不健康的苍白，瘦瘦弱弱的像是一阵风就能吹倒的文弱书生。“要不，明天我带你去找村长，先把名报上？”“好！”“饿不饿，想不想吃点啥？”“还想吃你炸的串。”“啊？从小吃到大的，还没吃够啊？”“吃不够，一辈子都吃不够。”袁爱琴很久没有笑的这么开心过。当年造纸厂倒闭，她成了下岗工人。几经波折，跟着人家后头学着摆摊，在学校门口卖起炸串。生意时好时坏，还经常被城管撵着跑，风里来雨里去的，时间久了袁爱琴因为过分操劳，也导致模样比年龄大出许多。透过窗户，看着院子里的母亲重新将油锅升温，把夜市卖剩下的食材一股脑的丢进锅里。噼里啪啦的油炸声，伴随着扑鼻香气飘出，陆阳内心的激动无以言表。前世，他的成绩还算不错，但就是因为迷恋上了网络小说，才导致成绩一落千丈。什么《邻家女孩儿初长成》《阿兵传奇》《很纯很暧昧》都是当下最经典小说。高考落榜后，陆阳并未选择复读，而是去上了技校。逃课上网，迟到睡觉，打架斗殴在那是基本操作。甚至，陆阳于在学期间，那所学校还因厕所产子上过新闻。在如此糟糕的环境下，陆阳变得愈发堕落。不仅更加沉迷小说，道德和三观甚至都逐渐变得扭曲起来。毕业后的北上，现实却狠狠给了他无数个大耳光。没有技术，也没有文凭的他，在求职路上处处碰壁。于是，他只能去送外卖，跑滴滴，送快递，干销售，卖保险，捏脚推拿......因为形象气质不错，陆阳甚至还放下尊严，去酒吧当过一段时间模子哥。不得不说，当你放下道德底线的时候，这钱是来得快，就是腰有点儿吃不消。但好景不长一次投资失败，让陆阳一夜回到解放前。最终只能和绝大多数北漂一样，灰溜溜的提着行李，回到当初的小县城。看着朋友圈里那些留在当地发展同学，一个个成家立业有车有房幸福美满的生活，一事无成的陆阳除了羡慕只有羡慕。如果当初，他没有去读那个破技校，没有染上那些坏习惯，或许也不会变成现在这样。“三十年河东，三十年河西，莫欺少年穷。”这是陆阳中二时的座右铭，当初的他相信总有逆境翻盘的那一天。但后来才知道，莫欺少年穷后头，还有莫欺中年穷，莫欺老年穷。小说这东西，看看就行了，别太当真了。你以为你是主角，但实际上只是万魂幡里的杂鱼。认清楚这点后，陆阳决心这一世踏踏实实的，一步一个脚印的往前走。见识过未来龙国强大军力，陆阳也为自已即将成为一名光荣的龙国军人感到兴奋和自豪。很快，一托盘热气腾腾的炸串就端上桌，裹满秘制酱料，撒上孜然辣椒粉。光是闻着就让人口水直流，食指大动。陆勇强泡了碗面，也跟着吃了点，但脸上哪里还有怒火。他心里确实高兴，一块五的好劲道都比平日里更香了。儿子下决心去当兵，这是一件好事。对于他们这种不富裕的家庭来说，即便考上大学，学费和生活费也是一笔不小的开销。就算毕业出来，现在就业形势那么严峻，也不知道能不能找到合适的工作。而陆阳选择去当兵，家里的担子一下子就减轻了很多，回头退伍了工作也好找一些。陆勇强三哥家孩子就当过兵，退伍回来正好赶上事业单位在招退伍军人，然后就端上了事业单位的铁饭碗。所以，陆勇强寻思着，等儿子退伍回来，托关系找人，要是也能安排个这样舒服体面的工作也挺好。起码铁饭碗，旱涝保丰收。他们夫妻俩这些年，也可以多存点钱，回头给儿子结婚买房。陆阳郑重的说：“爸，妈，我一定会好好当兵，在部队里混出个人样来，给你们瞧瞧！”“好！”陆勇强咧个大嘴，笑的别提多开心了。母亲袁爱琴借口倒水，转身时却拧着嘴唇红了眼眶。孩子有主见，懂事了，她很是高兴。但想到未来两年都见不着面，还得吃那么多苦，她心里万般不舍，很不是滋味。当父母的，从来不求子女大富大贵，只希望平平安安，平平淡淡就好。但这一世，陆阳不想再浑浑噩噩，他想在部队里混出个名堂来。为了自已，也为了家人。......“你进去吧，我在外头等你。”一周后的上午，父亲骑着小电驴，载着陆阳来到市人民医院体检中心。陆阳报名已经通过，征兵干部也来家里走访过，基本上只要体检通过，就可以等待人武部的入伍通知了。但这也是陆勇强最担心的一点，因为自家孩子什么身体素质他最清楚。别体检通不过，部队不肯要就完了？但父亲的担心是多余的，陆阳这些天一直胡吃海塞的补充营养，已然胖了几斤。再加上适当跑步锻炼，身体素质应该好了点，小小征兵体检能有什么难度？陆阳走进体检中心，里头有不少年轻人和他一样，都是来征兵体检的。征兵体检日期，通常在正式报名后的一到两周内，具体时间由人武部协调安排。只要是身体上没有重大缺陷，重大疾病，纹身，明显疤痕的大多都能通过。有意思的是，陆阳等待体检时候，忽然在走廊里闻着一股香喷喷的烤羊肉串味儿。询问过后，才了解到是一个哥们儿有狐臭，体检还没开始呢，就被征兵办强行劝退了。想想也是，要是真让他去到部队里，同宿舍的战友每天得多煎熬多痛苦？上了战场，敌人不用眼睛看，光用鼻子闻，就能精准找到他的藏身地。“吸气，呼气，用力吹。”“好，拿着单子去那边吧。”测完肺活量，陆阳便来到检验色盲色弱的地方。他从小喜欢画画，对颜色使用和把控很不错。之前因为成绩下滑，家人甚至准备走艺术，但艺考费用实在太高，于是就放弃了。“这是几？”“这是......”陆阳愣了一下，因为他发现竟有些看不清卡片上的数字......
content_en: "You piece of shit!" "You lied to me when I was in school, saying that I went to Xinhua Bookstore to buy tutorial books, but what I ended up buying was this kind of thing!" "I let you read novels, I let you read novels, and then I sold these books to you for scrap!" Lu Yang was shocked and woke up suddenly.Looking at the familiar house and the man in front of him who was tearing up books in a mad rage, his eyes were full of confusion.He clearly remembered that he was driving screws on the assembly line a second ago, and then he was here the next time he opened his eyes.Soon, Lu Yang suddenly realized that he seemed to be reborn?I went back to twenty years ago, the summer vacation after I failed the college entrance examination.At this moment, I was secretly reading a novel in my bedroom, and then my father rushed in angrily."I gave you food, drink, and borrowed money to send you to high school, just because I wanted you to get into a good university!" "But you didn't study well, so you just read these crappy novels all day long!" "I'm telling you, Lu Yang, your good days are over. Now there are two ways for you, either go to work in a factory or go to a technical school to learn a trade. It's your choice?" His father Lu Yongqiang's roar was deafening, and spittle sprayed Lu Yang's face.But Lu Yang felt a sore nose, feeling not only guilty but also uncomfortable.Because in the previous life, although my father was strict, he always cared about me in his heart.In order to save money to buy a house for Lu Yang to get married, he worked overtime at work during the day and secretly delivered food after work behind his family's back.Finally, he became ill from overwork and fell on the electric car seat from exhaustion on a cold winter evening... At this time, the sound of a tricycle stopping was heard outside. His mother, Yuan Aiqin, was setting up a stall at the night market. When she came back from her stall, she happened to hear the noise in the house.She didn't care much. She didn't even have time to take off her sleeves before she hurried in. Then she saw the mess all over the ground and thought something big had happened.Yuan Aiqin almost instinctively pushed her husband away and protected Lu Yang behind her, like an angry lioness: "What are you doing in the middle of the night!?" Lu Yong was very angry: "I just got off the night shift. When I came back, I saw this little kid staying awake most of the night, reading novels with a flashlight. I was so angry that I tore up the book for him..." Lu Yang quickly promised: "Dad, I will never read this again.It's a mess of novels.I'll return the books at dawn tomorrow." Lu Yongqiang glared: "The books were borrowed?" Lu Yang nodded: "Three cents a day, deposit is 20." He looked down at the two books on the ground and said awkwardly: "There is no way to refund the deposit for these two books.Let's sell them for scrap."Mother is more pleased that it is always a good thing to be aware of mistakes and willing to correct them.She comforted Lu Yang: "Son, your father and I have actually discussed it and are going to find someone to pay for you to repeat your studies for a year." "You have always had good grades. As long as you study hard, you will definitely be able to get into a good university." However, Lu Yang shook his head and refused. It was not that he was unwilling to repeat his studies.But the gap has been too long, and he has long returned to the teacher what he learned at the beginning.Even if I repeat the exam for a year, I'm afraid I won't get any good results.Rather than wasting a year in vain, it is better to choose a new path.Lu Yang recalled in his memory that a few days after he failed the exam, the village chief came to his door and asked him if he wanted to become a soldier.The village committee is responsible for cooperating with the Ministry of Human Resources and Armed Forces' recruitment propaganda work. If there are young people of suitable age, they will naturally come to inquire. In addition, the village chief is Lu Yang's uncle, so he is naturally more concerned about this.But at that time, Lu Yang was extremely resistant to joining the army, so he refused without even thinking.But after experiencing severe beatings and torture from society, Lu Yang thought about it.Being a soldier is hard on the body; entering the society is a double torture of both the spirit and the body, as well as all kinds of intrigues and intrigues.In comparison, the environment in the army is much better. As long as you work hard, you will be rewarded.They have all been reborn, who will continue to study again?Just become a soldier!"Dad, I don't want to repeat my studies, and I don't want to go to technical school." Upon hearing this, Lu Yongqiang instinctively thought that he was talking back.First he reached for his waist and found that he had no habit of wearing a belt.Then his eyes searched around the room, trying to see if there was any useful weapon."Dad, what are you looking for? I'll help you find it?" "I'm looking for a stick to beat you to death, you little cannon!" "..." Lu Yongqiang yelled: "If you don't want to repeat your studies or go to technical school, what are you going to do? You want to go to heaven? You dropped out of school to work when you were 18 or 19 years old. Can you endure the hardship and afford this person?" Lu Yang was sprayed with spit on his face, but his tone was very firm: "Dad, I have thought about it, I want to be aSoldier." His mother was very surprised: "A few days ago, when your uncle came here, didn't you say you didn't want to be a soldier?What else did you say, you have to find a job after you become a soldier, why not go to a technical school to learn skills?" Lu Yang said frankly: "The military pay is good, and you will have retirement pay, and it will be easier to find a job as a retired soldier." The couple obviously didn't expect that Lu Yang would overturn his previous idea so quickly, like he was reading a book?But their first reaction was not whether their son would endure hardship after joining the army.But I am thinking, can the army want our son?As skinny as a penny, you only read novels all day long, and don’t exercise or play ball?You know, before the age of ten, Lu Yang was basically a medicine bottle, and he had to go to the hospital for injections almost every now and then.This also resulted in Lu Yang's complexion always showing an unhealthy paleness, and he was as thin and frail as a frail scholar who could be knocked down by a gust of wind."How about I take you to the village chief tomorrow and register your name first?" "Okay!" "Are you hungry? Do you want to eat something?" "I still want to eat your fried skewers." "Ah? You haven't eaten enough since you were a snack?" "Not enough, you will never have enough in your life." Yuan Aiqin had not laughed so happily in a long time.When the paper mill closed down, she became a laid-off worker.After many twists and turns, he followed others and learned to set up a stall, selling fried skewers in front of the school.Business was up and down, and she was often chased away by the urban management. She was exposed to wind and rain. Over time, Yuan Aiqin looked much older than her age due to overwork.Through the window, I watched my mother in the yard heat up the oil pan again and throw the leftover ingredients from the night market into the pan.The crackling sound of frying, accompanied by the tangy aroma wafting out, made Lu Yang indescribably excited.In his previous life, his grades were pretty good, but it was because he became obsessed with online novels that his grades plummeted."The Girl Next Door Grows Up", "The Legend of Soldier" and "Very Pure and Ambiguous" are the most classic novels at the moment.After failing the college entrance examination, Lu Yang went to a technical school instead of repeating his studies.Skipping classes and surfing the Internet, staying late to bed, and getting into fights were basic operations there.Even when Lu Yangyu was in school, the school was in the news for giving birth in the toilet.In such a bad environment, Lu Yang became more and more depraved.Not only did he become more addicted to novels, his moral and three views even gradually became distorted.After graduation, when he went north, reality gave him countless slaps in the face.With no skills and no diploma, he encountered obstacles on his way to job hunting.Therefore, he could only deliver food, run Didi, deliver express, do sales, sell insurance, massage feet... Because of his good image and temperament, Lu Yang even put aside his dignity and worked as a model brother in a bar for a while.I have to say that when you put down your moral bottom line, the money comes quickly, but it is a bit too much for your waist.But good times don't last long. An investment failure brings Lu Yang back to before liberation overnight.In the end, I could only carry my luggage in despair and return to the small county town like most Beipiao.Looking at the students in his circle of friends who stayed in the local area to develop their careers, and all of them were getting married, starting a business, owning a car and a house, and living a happy life, Lu Yang, who had accomplished nothing, could only be envious.If he hadn't gone to that crappy technical school and gotten into those bad habits, maybe he wouldn't be like this."Thirty years in Hedong, thirty years in Hexi, don't bully young people into poverty." This was Lu Yang's motto when he was in the second year of middle school. At that time, he believed that there would always be a day when adversity would turn the tables.But later I learned that don’t bully young people into poverty, don’t bully middle-aged people into poverty, and don’t bully old people into poverty.This is a novel, just read it, don’t take it too seriously.You think you are the protagonist, but in fact you are just a miscellaneous fish in the Ten Thousand Souls Banner.After realizing this, Lu Yang was determined to move forward step by step in this life.Having seen the powerful military power of the Dragon Kingdom in the future, Lu Yang was also excited and proud that he was about to become a glorious Dragon Kingdom soldier.Soon, a tray of steaming hot fried skewers was brought to the table, covered in secret sauce and sprinkled with cumin and chili powder.Just smelling it makes people's mouth water and their index fingers move.Lu Yongqiang made a bowl of noodles and ate some, but there was no anger on his face.He was indeed happy in his heart, and the good taste of a dollar and a half tasted better than usual.It is a good thing that my son is determined to become a soldier.For a poor family like theirs, even if they are admitted to college, tuition and living expenses are still a huge expense.Even after graduation, the current employment situation is so grim, I don’t know if I can find a suitable job.But Lu Yang chose to join the army, and the burden on his family was suddenly relieved a lot. It would be easier to find a job after he retired from the army.Lu Yongqiang's third brother's children had served in the military. When they came back from the army, the public institutions were recruiting veterans, and then they got the iron rice bowl of the public institutions.Therefore, Lu Yongqiang thought that when his son came back from the army, he could use his connections to find someone. It would be great if he could arrange such a comfortable and decent job.At least the iron rice bowl ensures a bumper harvest despite drought and floods.The couple can save more money over the years and buy a house for their son when he gets married.Lu Yang said solemnly: "Dad, Mom, I will definitely serve as a soldier well and make a difference in the army, let you see!" "Okay!"
